spell_schools.name: Conjuration
spell_schools.description: Summoning objects and creatures or teleporting.

spell_schools.name: Illusion
spell_schools.description: Deceiving the senses with false images.

spell_schools.name: Transmutation
spell_schools.description: Changing the properties of creatures or objects.

spell_schools.name: Evocation
spell_schools.description: Projecting elemental energy and raw magic.

damage_types.name: Acid
damage_types.description: Corrosive substances that burn away material.

damage_types.name: Bludgeoning
damage_types.description: Impact from weapons or falling objects.

damage_types.name: Necrotic
damage_types.description: Decay, entropy, and draining life force.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: A blinded creature can't see and automatically fails any ability check that requires sight.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.description: A charmed creature can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with harmful abilities or magical effects.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.description: A deafened creature can't hear and automatically fails any ability check that requires hearing.

conditions.name: Exhaustion
conditions.description: Progressive penalties from extreme physical or mental strain.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.description: A frightened creature has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of its fear is within line of sight.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.description: Speed becomes 0, and the grappled creature can't benefit from any bonus to its speed.

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.description: An incapacitated creature can't take actions or reactions.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.description: An invisible creature is impossible to see without the aid of magic or a special sense.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.description: A paralyzed creature is incapacitated and can't move or speak.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.description: A petrified creature is transformed into a solid inanimate substance.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: A poisoned creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: A prone creature's only movement option is to crawl.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.description: Speed becomes 0, and attack rolls against the creature have advantage.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: A stunned creature is incapacitated and can't move.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: An unconscious creature is incapacitated, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings.
